competitive_changes: Starting in 12.01 in EU, accounts detected for sharing and all Ascendant+ players must enable Riot Mobile multi-factor authentication (MFA) to access Competitive queue. Other modes will remain unaffected. (wiki editor note: this was already in effect since 12.00.)

You can check out [https://playvalorant.com/en-us/news/game-updates/riot-mobile-verification-beta/ this article] for more information on why we're making this change, or get yourself set up with MFA now using this [https://playvalorant.com/en-us/news/game-updates/riot-mobile-verification-beta/ how-to guide].
bug_fixes: Agents
General
Bugfix Fixed a bug where ability icons would not update if a player was debuffed repeatedly with the same type of debuff by the same agent.
Harbor
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Harbor’s Reckoning overworld range indicator was not lining up with the actual ability.
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Harbor’s Cove was missing an ability icon when viewing it on the placement minimap.
Fade
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Fade’s Prowler was missing a VFX asset when viewed in Left Handed Mode.
Gekko
Bugfix Buff Fixed a rare bug where Gekko's Dizzy would sometimes aim at detected players incorrectly (and miss).
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Gekko’s globules were sometimes visible on the enemy minimap even when out of sight.
Viper
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Viper’s Viper's Pit was only showing inconsistent VFX when an observer was on freecam within it.
Chamber / Veto
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Chamber’s Rendezvous and Veto’s Crosscut indicators would overlap on agents and make them difficult to see.
Killjoy
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Killjoy’s neck and hair clip would shift inconsistently while moving with an Odin equipped.
Sage
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Sage’s Healing Orb targeting UI was still visible on allies who broke Sage’s line of sight.
Phoenix
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Phoenix would remain nearsighted from certain abilities after respawning from Run it Back.
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Phoenix’s Hot Hands VFX trail would sometimes emerge from an inaccurate location when thrown from B Window on Bind.
Yoru
Bugfix Fixed a rare bug where Yoru could use and instantly cancel Dimensional Drift by casting Gatecrash right as the buy phase barrier dropped.
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Yoru’s Fakeout clone could be pushed away by Veto’s Chokehold if Chokehold was on an elevated surface.
Modes
All Random One Site
Bugfix Nerf Fixed an issue where Agents with continuous Ultimates (e.g. Reyna) drop an Ultimate Orb on death.
Bugfix Fixed a text overrun that could occur in certain localizations on console within the Next Random Agent widget.
Bugfix Fixed a glass breaking audio event on Ascent when A site is out of bounds.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Loadouts would occasionally reset to default selections.
Gameplay Systems
Bugfix Fixed an issue where bullet tracers sometimes wouldn't appear after shooting through a wall.
Premier
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Premier team tags were sometimes not displayed in the custom game lobby and other social modals.
Bugfix Fixed an issue where long Premier team names and tags were sometimes overlapping.
